author: Paul Danter
title: Children's book illustrator wanted for Luna and the Little Star
content: CHILDREN'S BOOK ILLUSTRATOR WANTED. We're looking for an experienced illustrator to bring our upcoming children's fantasy picture book, "Luna and the Little Star," to life. Project: 28 illustrated pages + cover artwork. Style: Soft, whimsical, painterly, and 3D-inspired. Important: Strong character consistency across different scenes, poses, and expressions. Type: Professional paid project. To apply, DM with portfolio, previous children's book illustration work, rates, availability, and AI usage policy. A paid sample illustration may be requested before the full project begins. Contact: DM @pauldanter16.
